t: This is All Saints Church in Haggerston, an Anglican church on Livermere Road, near the junction with Haggerston Road, in the London Borough of Hackney. It belongs to a parish together with Holy Trinity Church and St Philip Dalston. The architect was Philip Hardwick, who is best known for the Euston Arch, now demolished, and for the original Birmingham Curzon Street station, which is the oldest railway terminus building in the world. Here he designed a church instead.
